title: TATB 3
speaker: Zoketsu Norman Fischer
summary: The talk emphasizes the importance of understanding Buddhist teachings as a way to challenge our existing notions of reality, rather than literal descriptions of entities. It suggests that these teachings are meant to be antidotes to our preconceived ideas, which can lead to suffering, and instead aim to reveal a more neutral and liberating truth about the nature of consciousness. By questioning our assumptions about what it means to be human or conscious, we may discover a more authentic understanding that is free from conceptual frameworks and allows for greater freedom and living in the present moment.
